one_line: A DPO construction recipe that derives preference labels from repeated-answer self-consistency.
ScPO 对同一问题采样多份答案，依据答案频次把更一致的回答作为偏好对的正例，用 DPO 训练模型偏向一致答案。
why: It makes a key Track 5 conversion explicit—rollout counts become preference data—but requires raw samples and split discipline to audit leakage.
inclusion_reason: It makes a key Track 5 conversion explicit—rollout counts become preference data—but requires raw samples and split discipline to audit leakage.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Self-Consistency Preference Optimization (ICML 2025, PMLR 267) addresses self-training for reasoning when gold answers are absent and an external reward model may be unreliable out of distribution. Standard inference-time self-consistency samples several solutions and chooses the most frequent final answer. SCPO asks whether that frequency signal can instead create preference supervision for model training.

The primary data object is an iteratively generated preference record: unlabeled seed or model-generated problem, k sampled responses with rationales and parsed final answers, answer-equivalence clusters, vote count for each cluster, one chosen response from the highest-vote cluster, one rejected response from the lowest-vote cluster, vote-margin weight, filtering threshold, iteration/model version, and optional gold-label provenance in the semi-supervised variant. The paper reports this construction and experiments but the accepted artifacts do not identify an official preference-pair dataset, rollout log, or code release. Consensus is a programmatic proxy, not a ground-truth verifier, so shared model error must remain visible.

《Self-Consistency Preference Optimization》（ICML 2025，PMLR 267）研究缺少 gold answer、且外部 reward model 可能在分布外失效时的推理自训练。标准推理时 self-consistency 会采样多个解答并选择最常见最终答案；SCPO 考察能否把这种频次信号转成模型训练的偏好监督。

主要数据对象是迭代生成的偏好记录：无标签 seed 或模型生成问题、k 个带 rationale 与解析最终答案的采样回答、答案等价簇、各簇票数、从最高票簇抽取的 chosen 回答、从最低票簇抽取的 rejected 回答、票差权重、过滤阈值、iteration 与模型版本，以及半监督变体中的可选 gold-label provenance。论文报告了该构造与实验，但已接受 artifacts 未识别官方偏好对数据集、rollout 日志或代码发布。共识是程序化 proxy，而不是 ground-truth verifier，因此共享模型错误必须显式保留。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
At iteration t, the current model samples k responses for each problem. A vote function extracts final answers and counts exact answer agreement. The most frequent answer cluster supplies the chosen response, the least frequent cluster supplies the rejected response, and the pair is retained only if the chosen vote reaches threshold tau. When several responses share an answer, one response is sampled from that cluster. Pair weight w is the chosen-minus-rejected vote margin divided by k.

Training uses a weighted objective combining DPO against the current model as reference with a weighted NLL term on the chosen response. The resulting model generates the next iteration's preference data. SCPO also prompts Llama-3 Instruct 8B to create new problems; answer-consistency filtering removes generated problems without a sufficiently supported answer. In the semi-supervised variant, gold-correct and gold-incorrect responses form pairs with weight one, while unlabeled items retain the consistency rule.

Relative to inference-only self-consistency, SCPO converts rollout counts into persistent preference examples and distills the voting distribution into a single-sample model. Relative to reward-model self-training or LMSI, it uses answer frequency rather than an external scalar judge and optimizes weighted preference plus NLL rather than NLL alone. This directly fits Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data because repeated samples, answer groups, rejected responses, and vote margins define the training object.

在 iteration t，当前模型为每个问题采样 k 个回答。vote function 提取最终答案并统计答案精确一致次数。最高频答案簇提供 chosen 回答，最低频答案簇提供 rejected 回答；只有 chosen 票数达到阈值 tau 时才保留该偏好对。当同一答案对应多个回答时，从该簇随机抽取一个回答。偏好对权重 w 等于 chosen 与 rejected 的票差除以 k。

训练目标把相对当前模型作为 reference 的加权 DPO，与 chosen 回答上的加权 NLL 项结合。训练后的模型再生成下一 iteration 的偏好数据。SCPO 还提示 Llama-3 Instruct 8B 生成新问题；若生成问题没有得到足够一致支持的答案，就由一致性过滤器移除。半监督变体使用 gold-correct 与 gold-incorrect 回答构造权重为一的偏好对，无标签条目仍使用一致性规则。

相对只在推理时使用 self-consistency，SCPO 把 rollout 计数转为持久偏好样本，并把投票分布蒸馏进单次采样模型。相对 reward-model 自训练或 LMSI，它用答案频次代替外部标量 judge，并优化加权 preference 与 NLL，而不是只用 NLL。它直接属于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，因为重复采样、答案分组、拒绝回答和票差共同定义训练对象。

title: Method
方法
html:
SCPO begins with a base model and unlabeled seed queries. For GSM8K and MATH it uses Llama-3 Base 8B as the seed model; for ZebraLogic it uses Llama-3 Instruct 8B. Llama-3 Instruct 8B generates additional problems from four-shot train examples for math or by one-shot rephrasing/perturbation for ZebraLogic. Responses and new problems are sampled at temperature 0.7 and top-p 0.9.

For GSM8K and MATH, k=8 responses are first sampled. If later models become too consistent to yield a rejected answer, another eight responses are generated. Initial generated-problem and pair filtering uses tau=0.5k; for second-iteration data it rises to 0.7k on GSM8K and 0.6k on MATH. ZebraLogic uses k=16 because exact table-answer collisions are rarer, with tau=2 for M1 and tau=0.5k for M2. The main loop trains M1 then M2 using the weighted DPO-plus-NLL loss. Gold-labeled semi-supervised pairs use correctness and weight one.

The paper evaluates GSM8K, MATH, and the test-only ZebraLogic benchmark, with held-out dev splits for math model selection. It reports ten training epochs and learning rate 5e-6 with cosine scheduling; complete reproduction still requires prompts, parser/equivalence rules, random cluster-member selection, alpha/beta settings, seeds, generated questions, all rollouts, and exact checkpoints. Appendix D provides prompts, but no official code, pair files, or versioned rollout release was confirmed.

SCPO 从基础模型和无标签 seed query 开始。GSM8K 与 MATH 使用 Llama-3 Base 8B 作为 seed model；ZebraLogic 使用 Llama-3 Instruct 8B。Llama-3 Instruct 8B 根据四个训练示例为数学任务生成新问题，或通过 one-shot 改写与扰动生成 ZebraLogic 问题。回答与新问题均以 temperature 0.7、top-p 0.9 采样。

GSM8K 与 MATH 首先采样 k=8 个回答。如果后续模型过于一致而无法产生 rejected 回答，则再生成 8 个回答。初始生成问题和偏好对过滤使用 tau=0.5k；第二 iteration 的数据在 GSM8K 上提高到 0.7k，在 MATH 上提高到 0.6k。ZebraLogic 的表格答案较难精确重复，因此使用 k=16；M1 使用 tau=2，M2 使用 tau=0.5k。主循环用加权 DPO 加 NLL loss 训练 M1，再训练 M2。带 gold label 的半监督偏好对按正确性构造，权重为一。

论文评测 GSM8K、MATH 和只有 test set 的 ZebraLogic，并为数学任务保留 dev split 做模型选择。报告训练十个 epoch，learning rate 为 5e-6，使用 cosine scheduling；完整复现仍需提示、parser 与等价规则、簇内随机抽样、alpha/beta 设置、seed、生成问题、全部 rollouts 和准确 checkpoint。Appendix D 给出提示，但未确认官方代码、偏好对文件或版本化 rollout 发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official PMLR record identifies the paper in the Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning, pages 49737–49751. Experiments report gains over the seed model and unsupervised baselines on GSM8K, MATH, and ZebraLogic. Ablations show the vote-margin-weighted loss outperforming an unweighted version in the reported settings, and threshold analysis on MATH demonstrates a quantity–quality trade-off: raising tau increases the measured chosen/rejected accuracy margin but sharply reduces retained pairs. Appendix analysis reports positive association between vote share and correctness and finds k=8 a compute/association compromise, with k=16 slightly stronger.

This evidence supports self-consistency frequency as a useful preference proxy on the studied parseable-answer tasks. It does not make plurality a verifier: correlated errors can produce a confident wrong cluster, and higher benchmark accuracy does not validate every chosen/rejected label. The transductive appendix experiment builds preference data using test queries and reports additional gains; it must remain separate from the primary train/dev/test protocol and must not be treated as leakage-free training evidence. No raw pairs, rollouts, or code were confirmed from the official PMLR page.

PMLR 官方记录显示，该论文收录于第 42 届 International Conference on Machine Learning 论文集，第 49737–49751 页。实验在 GSM8K、MATH 和 ZebraLogic 上报告了相对 seed model 与无监督基线的提升。消融显示，在报告设置中，票差加权 loss 优于不加权版本；MATH 的阈值分析展示数量—质量权衡：提高 tau 会增大测得的 chosen/rejected 正确率差，但会显著减少保留偏好对。Appendix 分析报告票占比与正确性正相关，并把 k=8 作为计算量与相关性的折中，k=16 略强。

这些证据支持在所研究、答案可解析任务上把 self-consistency 频次作为有用偏好 proxy。它不能把 plurality 变成 verifier：相关错误会形成高置信错误簇，更高 benchmark accuracy 也不能验证每个 chosen/rejected 标签。transductive appendix 实验使用 test query 构造偏好数据并报告额外增益；它必须与主要 train/dev/test 协议分开，不能被描述为无泄漏训练证据。从官方 PMLR 页面未确认 raw pair、rollout 或代码发布。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Self-consistency previously aggregated multiple inference-time answers, while self-training methods used gold answers, an external reward model, model-as-judge scores, or consistency-selected targets for supervised NLL. SCPO turns final-answer frequency into pairwise preferences, weights each pair by the vote margin, combines weighted DPO with chosen-response NLL, and repeats the construction over model iterations. It also uses the same consistency signal to filter self-generated problems.

The direction signal is a precise conversion from rollout data to preference data: sampled response groups become chosen/rejected records with confidence-like weights and explicit filtering thresholds. This makes sample count, answer parser, cluster definition, vote margin, and iteration lineage essential audit fields. The semi-supervised variant also cleanly separates gold-derived pairs from proxy-derived pairs.

Neither self-consistency, DPO, NLL, iterative self-training, nor problem generation is new alone. The novelty is their vote-weighted preference construction for reasoning without training answers. The method's measured gains and vote–accuracy association are useful quality signals at aggregate level, but they do not prove each preference pair is correct or the unreleased corpus is reusable.

以往 self-consistency 用于聚合多次推理答案，而自训练方法使用 gold answer、外部 reward model、model-as-judge 分数，或把一致性选出的 target 用于监督 NLL。SCPO 把最终答案频次转换成 pairwise preference，以票差为每对样本加权，把加权 DPO 与 chosen-response NLL 结合，并在模型 iteration 间重复构造。它还用同一一致性信号过滤自生成问题。

其方向性信号是一条清晰的 rollout 数据到偏好数据转换：采样回答组变成带类置信权重和显式过滤阈值的 chosen/rejected 记录。这使采样数、答案 parser、聚类定义、票差和 iteration lineage 都成为必要审计字段。半监督变体也明确区分 gold-derived pair 与 proxy-derived pair。

self-consistency、DPO、NLL、迭代自训练和问题生成单独看都不是新概念。新意在于面向无训练答案推理任务的票数加权偏好构造。方法的总体增益和票数—正确性关联是聚合层面的质量信号，但不能证明每个偏好对正确，也不能证明未发布语料可复用。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
SCPO assumes a parseable, unambiguous final answer and that repeated agreement correlates with correctness. Shared misconceptions, deterministic decoding modes, answer-normalization errors, and semantically equivalent but textually different answers can distort votes. As training increases consistency, response diversity falls and rejected examples become harder to obtain, which is why later rounds require extra sampling and higher thresholds.

The main experiments cover Llama-3/3.1 8B families and math or logic tasks; extension to open-ended outputs is left for future work. ZebraLogic provides only test puzzles, and the appendix's use of test queries for transductive preference construction changes the evaluation boundary. No code, generated queries, raw responses, pair selections, random choices, or licenses are released through the accepted links. Dataset contamination and generated-problem duplication controls are not established. Aggregate performance does not certify preference-label quality.

SCPO 假设最终答案可解析且无歧义，并假设重复一致与正确性相关。共享误解、确定性较强的解码、答案归一化错误，以及语义等价但文本不同的答案都会扭曲票数。随着训练提高一致性，回答多样性下降，rejected 样本更难获得，因此后续轮次需要额外采样和更高阈值。

主要实验覆盖 Llama-3/3.1 8B 系列以及数学或逻辑任务；开放式输出的扩展留待未来工作。ZebraLogic 只有 test puzzle，Appendix 使用 test query 做 transductive 偏好构造改变了评测边界。已接受链接没有发布代码、生成问题、原始回答、偏好对选择、随机抽样结果或许可证。数据污染与生成问题重复控制也未确认。聚合性能不能认证偏好标签质量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data track, SCPO is a direct example of converting repeated-sampling traces into optimizer-ready preference records. A reusable schema should preserve every response, parsed answer, answer cluster, vote count, chosen/rejected member, selection randomness, vote-margin weight, threshold, generator checkpoint, iteration, query provenance, and whether the label came from consensus or gold correctness.

Such data could support preference optimization, calibration of consensus confidence, comparisons between external reward models and self-consistency, threshold studies, and audits of diversity collapse across iterations. It can also expose leakage by separating ordinary train-split construction from transductive use of test queries. These uses depend on raw trace and split provenance; because no official pair corpus is confirmed, the paper currently offers a construction recipe rather than a downloadable preference dataset.

对 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 方向，SCPO 是把重复采样轨迹直接转换为 optimizer-ready 偏好记录的案例。可复用 schema 应保留每个回答、解析答案、答案簇、票数、chosen/rejected 成员、选择随机性、票差权重、阈值、生成 checkpoint、iteration、问题 provenance，以及标签来自共识还是 gold correctness。

这类数据可用于 preference optimization、校准共识置信、比较外部 reward model 与 self-consistency、研究阈值，并审计 iteration 间的多样性坍缩。通过区分普通 train-split 构造和 transductive test-query 使用，它还可暴露泄漏风险。这些用途依赖原始轨迹与 split provenance；由于未确认官方偏好对语料，当前论文提供的是构造 recipe，而不是可下载偏好数据集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• SCPO clusters k sampled responses by parsed final answer and selects highest-vote versus lowest-vote groups.
  • Pair weight is the chosen–rejected vote margin divided by k; training combines weighted DPO and NLL.
  • The reported construction uses k=8 for GSM8K/MATH and k=16 for ZebraLogic with task- and iteration-specific thresholds.
  • Consensus is a proxy that can amplify shared errors; benchmark gains do not validate each pair.
  • The transductive test-query experiment and the absence of released pairs, rollouts, and code are major audit boundaries.

• SCPO 按解析后的最终答案对 k 个采样回答聚类，并选择最高票组与最低票组。
  • 偏好对权重是 chosen 与 rejected 票差除以 k；训练结合加权 DPO 和 NLL。
  • 报告构造在 GSM8K/MATH 上用 k=8，在 ZebraLogic 上用 k=16，并使用依任务与 iteration 变化的阈值。
  • 共识只是可能放大共享错误的 proxy；benchmark 增益不能验证每个偏好对。
  • transductive test-query 实验，以及未发布偏好对、rollout 和代码，是主要审计边界。
